digest.component_or_area: reliability test oracles (snapshot stall abort, ACLI subprocess timeout)
propositions: Two acceptance tests use production-scale real-time values (15s loopback server, 1s per-attempt deadline) that cause long wall-clock delays despite testing logical contracts (throughput window, retry schedule, process cleanup) rather than elapsed seconds.
Snapshot stall test must serve real loopback traffic above the configured floor for more than one complete injected window (1s) without being classified as a stall abort.

ACLI read-retry test must launch exactly _MAX_ATTEMPTS real child processes, observe the exact production retry schedule [2, 4] without actual sleep delays, and record every spawned PID with polling proof of cleanup.
Production timeout, stall window, grace/drain, attempt count, and backoff defaults must remain byte-unchanged with no wall-clock pass threshold or assertion added.
